title: CBS News anchor John Dickerson becomes latest figure to exit network
summary: Announcement comes amid concerns about network’s ownership and ability to maintain editorial independence John Dickerson, a longtime CBS News journalist, has become the latest high-profile figure to resign from the network amid concerns about its ownership and ability to maintain editorial independence. Dickerson, who over 16 years at the news organization has served in a variety of roles, including moderator of Face the Nation and chief political analyst, announced on Instagram that he would leave at the end of the year.
